subject: [PATCH v3 3/8] nfsd: don't stamp over an applied delegated mtime at DELEGRETURN

2026-11-09.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the NFSv4 server where the mtime of a file is overwritten by the current time when a delegated write operation is completed, even if the client has already applied its own mtime. The patch ensures that the mtime is only updated if it passes the ctime check, and sets the ctime to the current time in this case. It also shares the vetting function between SETATTR and CB_GETATTR operations to prevent divergent behavior.
